question: Which mantra elements are assigned to protect the northwest and northern quarters?
premises: The syllables hrīṃ hrīṃ are invoked in the northwest.
Svāhā is invoked in the north.
Protection is requested always in the north.
inference: Hrīṃ hrīṃ guards the northwest while svāhā provides constant protection in the north.
plain_english: May hrīṃ hrīṃ protect in the northwest; may svāhā always protect in the north.
